row.proto: uint64_t Ui_TileList_NavigateSelection(void *self, int *io_range, uint8_t dir_a_prev, uint8_t dir_a_next, uint8_t dir_b_prev, uint8_t dir_b_next)
row.notes: Returns 0 if bit 0x40 at self+0x119 is clear. Finds the index of the selection self+0x108 in the list self+0x150..+0x158 and, depending on which of the four direction flags is set and on the axis bit 1 at self+0x119, searches backward or forward for the next item whose vt+0xf8 and vt+0xf0 both return true (wrapping to the last or first item with bit 0x40 at +0x11a; nested rows are handled through 0x143840630 when the selection is a grandchild). On success it stores the old selection in self+0x110 and the new one in self+0x108 (or calls item vt+0x98(1) when bit 0x20 at +0x11a), dispatches event 0x519 with code 5 through vt+0x158/+0x160 and returns 1; on failure it raises one of the edge node events 0x1461055b0..0x1461055bc, dispatches code 6 and returns 0. In both cases io_range[0]/[1] are clamped with the tables at 0x14588ea30/0x14588ea48. Callers: the input handler 0x14383f800 passes four pressed-action bits; the node event handler 0x143832480 passes fixed prev/next flags for event ids 0x146105574..0x146105580 and then increments self+0xa0.
